bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
repo=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
work="$repo/.worktrees/creator-menu-20261115"
stage="$work/.gace-menu-offline-stage"
test "$(git -C "$work" rev-parse HEAD)" = d8de8f8912ee1d19b2a2bf2171c6cb66d51783a5 || { echo SOURCE_MISMATCH; exit 74; }
test "$(git -C "$repo" rev-parse HEAD)" = b69612c64c22af1540b7294625658ebffa946270 || { echo LIVE_ROOT_CHANGED; exit 74; }
test ! -e "$stage" || { echo OFFLINE_STAGE_EXISTS; exit 73; }
docker image inspect create-videobot:stars-sticker-shared-361267c >/dev/null
mkdir -p "$stage"
gh run download 43637297142 --repo seigo-gace/create-videobot --name createvdobot-runtime-deps --dir "$stage"
test -f "$stage/createvdobot-runtime-deps.tgz" || { echo ARTIFACT_MISSING; exit 74; }
tar -tzf "$stage/createvdobot-runtime-deps.tgz" | grep -q '^node_modules/undici/package.json$' || { echo UNDICI_ARTIFACT_MISSING; exit 74; }
tar -xzf "$stage/createvdobot-runtime-deps.tgz" -C "$stage"
for name in src owner sql web; do cp -a "$work/$name" "$stage/$name"; done
cat > "$stage/Dockerfile" <<'DOCKER'
FROM create-videobot:stars-sticker-shared-361267c
USER root
COPY --chown=node:node node_modules /opt/videobot/node_modules
COPY --chown=node:node src /opt/videobot/src
COPY --chown=node:node owner /opt/videobot/owner
COPY --chown=node:node sql /opt/videobot/sql
COPY --chown=node:node web /opt/videobot/web
USER node
DOCKER
docker build --pull=false --network none -t create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8 "$stage" >/tmp/createvdo-overlay-build-20261115.log 2>&1 || { tail -35 /tmp/createvdo-overlay-build-20261115.log; exit 1; }
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8 -e 'import("/opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorEgress.mjs").then(()=>console.log("UNDICI_MODULE=PASS")).catch(()=>process.exit(1))'
docker run --rm --network none --entrypoint node create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8 --check /opt/videobot/src/runtime/main.mjs
echo "MENU_SOURCE_SHA=d8de8f8912ee1d19b2a2bf2171c6cb66d51783a5"
docker image inspect --format 'CANDIDATE_IMAGE={{.Id}}' create-videobot:creator-menu-d8de8f8
docker inspect --format 'EXISTING_STATE={{.State.Status}} EXISTING_IMAGE={{.Image}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker inspect --format 'COMPOSE_PROJECT={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}} COMPOSE_SERVICE={{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.service"}}' gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
echo CREATEVDO_OFFLINE_STAGE=PASS
